# T-2: Report dirty flow metadata

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Add finalize-cleanup warning visibility for dirty main-repository specs/*/flow.json paths that belong to specs other than the finalized spec.

## Acceptance Criteria
- The warning lists relative dirty paths for non-target specs/*/flow.json files.
- The warning is absent when no non-target dirty specs/*/flow.json paths remain.
- The warning path does not stage, commit, stash, reset, delete, or modify the reported files.
- Already-staged non-target specs/*/flow.json paths are not included in the target finalize commit.
- Successful cleanup remains ok:true / exit 0 when only this warning condition is present.

## Implementation Notes
Use existing runGit/status helpers and Envelope warning conventions. Keep the scan bounded to specs/*/flow.json and exclude the finalized spec id. Include staged non-target flow.json paths in the safeguard before creating the target finalize commit.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local test should exercise a successful cleanup or extracted helper path with a dirty non-target flow.json and assert warning plus unchanged dirty state.
